# FLOP Airdrop Skill
> Autonomous AI agent skill for $FLOP airdrop positioning, Flop Network Proof-of-Useful-Inference (PoUI) architecture, and Flop Labs Technocore participation.

This repository provides instructions, scripts, and documentation allowing AI coding assistants and autonomous agent frameworks to guide users through the $FLOP airdrop without requiring manual coding.

## Core Documentation
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): Complete autonomous execution instructions triggered by "Help me with the $FLOP airdrop" or questions about Flop Network tokenomics/whitepaper teaser.
- [README.md](README.md): Comprehensive ecosystem overview, 3.5B airdrop tokenomics, 4-layer PoUI verification, 1-minute quick start (1-liner installer & npx skills), and framework compatibility.
- [docs/README_ID.md](docs/README_ID.md): Indonesian comprehensive guide.
- [docs/frameworks.md](docs/frameworks.md): Installation guides for Antigravity, Claude Code, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, and Cursor.
- [docs/contribution-templates.md](docs/contribution-templates.md): Ready-to-use templates for Teaser breakdowns, X threads, blog posts, and public evidence.

## Automation Tools & Installers
- [install.ps1](install.ps1): 1-liner automated Windows PowerShell installer.
- [install.sh](install.sh): 1-liner automated macOS/Linux installer.
- [scripts/agent_toolkit.py](scripts/agent_toolkit.py): Automated tool for Ed25519 DID creation, encrypted key management, and Technocore room signing.
- [scripts/requirements.txt](scripts/requirements.txt): Minimal dependencies (`cryptography`).
